# physics-2d

> Simulate 2D rigid bodies deterministically with SAT collision for convex polygons and circles, sequential impulses with restitution and friction, distance joints and sleeping C++20 library `physics-2d`, namespace `trysac::physics_2d`, CMake target
> `trysac::physics_2d`, MIT licensed, standard library only.
